text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PROD-P99-Latency for /v1/generate (rule: p99-latency > 700ms). Service: inference-runtime. Priority: P2. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/p99-latency.

pagerduty-bot: Escalation step 1: page sent to #eng-oncall. Attempting automatic dedupe/suppression window.

sam: ack  (taking) :hand:  I'll look at router & ingress metrics first. Anyone else seeing similar?

maria: I'm online, checking autoscaler and queue depth. Noted a small bump in request concurrency across region-us-west-2.

kevin: saw a tiny spike ~2.5m ago in kv-cache miss rate, could be warmup. grabbing logs from router-3.

sam: quick metrics snapshot (last 5m):
```
p99 latency: 860ms -> peak
p95 latency: 420ms
router-queue-depth: 18 -> baseline 6
kv-cache-miss-rate: 14% -> baseline 2%
```

sam: looks like short-lived juggle between queue build-up + higher miss rate. Could be transient rollout? any deploys in last 10m?

maria: no deploys in last 15m. Autoscaler did a small scale up for dedicated pool ~8m ago. I'm seeing one router pod with high CPU and GC churn.

kevin: pulling logs from that pod: `router-3` shows repeated `kv: timeout 200ms` and `retriable grpc error` lines. Could be network fanout to redis node.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert re-fired (flap detection). Count=2 within 6m. Not escalating to next rotation yet; auto-suppression window 10m remaining.

olivia: stepping in for takeover. reassigning to me @sam. Sam, pass on anything I should know.

sam: thanks. Priority mitigation: drain router-3, scale router pool +2, and spin new kv proxy. Commands I ran: 
```
kubectl -n inference cordon router-3
kubectl -n inference drain router-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/router --replicas=12
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/kv-proxy
```

olivia: applied scale +2. Draining router-3 now. Watching latency dashboards.

maria: I bumped the autoscaler window to 30s to avoid thrash. Also temporarily increased retry backoff on router to reduce immediate retries.

kevin: kv-proxy restarted, connecting to redis-primary looks clean. No error floods in logs now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert cleared for PROD-P99-Latency (duration ~7m). Auto-resolution detected.

sam: confirmed p99 back to ~220ms and queue depth to baseline. No customer impact detected in error-rate graphs.

olivia: taking channel for 10m post-checks. Please add timeline to the runbook if any follow-up needed.

maria: filing a small postmortem note: probable root cause - transient kv node networking jitter leading to cache miss spike -> router queueing -> tail latency. Action items: add additional kv-proxy healthchecks, tune retry/backoff, and add a short circuit for cache miss storms.

kevin: +1. I'll open a ticket with ops to analyze redis node network jitter and link to this thread.

sam: thumbs up. No customer incidents triggered. Closing thread in 30m unless anything else pops. :white_check_mark:

olivia: Thanks all. I'll follow up with a short runbook update. Good catch and fast handoff. :clap:
